purpose: Annual-income bracket labels for the 소득 part of 취업정보 신고. The analyzer surfaces a reminder that income bracket is reported alongside 직종·업종; exact live HiKorea bracket labels must be confirmed on the reporting screen.
verification_note: These bracket labels mirror data/jobcode_master.json#employment_reporting_context.income_bands and the overview material, but the EXACT current HiKorea dropdown labels/thresholds were not machine-verified from a live screen. Treat as a guide; confirm on HiKorea before final reporting. Do not present these as authoritative thresholds.
basis_note: 과세 전(세전) 연간소득 기준. 소득 '구간'이 바뀐 경우에만 변경 신고.
reminder_ko: HiKorea 취업정보 신고는 직종·업종과 함께 '연간소득 구간'도 신고합니다(과세 전 기준). 구간이 바뀐 경우에만 변경 신고하세요.
reminder_en: HiKorea employment reporting also requires an annual income bracket alongside occupation and industry (pre-tax). Report a change only when the bracket changes.
